title: 244 Spartina Circle at Camp WaterColor | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Overlooking Camp WaterColor + Outdoor Fireplace and Seating Area- 244 Spartina Circle at Camp WaterColor by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 244 Spartina Circle at Camp WaterColor by Royal Destinations Location: Camp District at WaterColor Address: 244 Spartina Circle, WaterColor, FL 32459 Details: Tucked in the Camp District of WaterColor, 244 Spartina Circle is a beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home comfortably sleeps up to 10 guests and sits just steps from Camp WaterColor. Enjoy easy access to the expanded WaterColor Beach Club (featuring multiple pools, lounge areas, and WaterColor Grill) plus community favorites like the community pools and fitness center. Inside, the open-concept layout features a freshly redecorated first floor. The kitchen is a chef’s dream with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, marble countertops, and a spacious island. Outdoor, relax on one of four inviting decks or gather around the outdoor fireplace. This location makes it easy to enjoy Seaside and WaterColor with six complimentary bikes, nearby nature trails, shops, and restaurants just a ride away. This home is perfectly designed for unforgettable family memories. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Overlooking Camp WaterColor (3 Community Pools, Soccer Field, Basketball Court, and Playground) - 6-Minute Bike Ride To WaterColor Beach Club - 5-Minute Bike Ride To Seaside - Outdoor Fireplace and Seating Area with Gourmet Gas Grill and Green Egg - 6 Complimentary Adult Bikes - Multiple Screened-In Extra Large Porches - Recently Redecorated First Floor - Flat-Screen TV's In Every Bedroom - Smart TV’s and Sonos System - Ping-Pong Table WaterColor Community Highlights: - Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. - WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. - A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community - Bike Community - Award-Winning Tennis Facilities - Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining - Nearby State Parks and Preserves - 4 Swimming Pools Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 10): Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bathroom (Shower) - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bathroom (Shower and Tub Combo) - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Bathroom (Shower) - Guest Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with Two Twin/Twin Beds and Shared Bathroom (Shower) -Laundry Room Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- We love our home right across from Camp WaterColor! It’s perfect for popping over for a quiet lunch or a quick swim. The open-concept, freshly redecorated first floor, three king beds, and four bunks fit our family perfectly. High-end Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, marble counters, and a large island make cooking a joy, and Publix is just minutes away. Four inviting decks (two screened and two with bed swings) offer plenty of spots to unwind, plus TVs in every bedroom and a big screen on the upper deck keep everyone entertained. Outside, enjoy a Wolf grill, Big Green Egg, and cozy fireplace. With two parking spots and bikes for beach trips, plus nearby trails, shops, and Seaside breakfasts, it’s the perfect place for quality family time. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore!
